profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | C#/.NET, Swift, TypeScript | Full-Stack & Mobile Development | Former Adobe Engineer
profile.summary: I have specialized in iOS and Android mobile development, wireless networking, and security for the past decade. Most recently I have been involved in projects as a team lead and full stack developer consisting of mobile and Azure components. I possess very strong debugging and problem-solving skills with over 25 years of experience. In that time my passion for code craftsmanship and learning new technologies has continued to evolve through personal and professional projects alike.
